title: Halfweg Sugar Factory
scope: The surviving east and west sugar silos and old lime kiln at the former Halfweg Sugar Factory, now SugarCity.
limitations: This entry represents the retained skyline structures. The neighboring event hall, mall and smaller factory buildings are outside the authored scope.
Roof levels and centers use the national surface survey. The exact window mosaic, exposed base structures and kiln platforms are estimated from the public-domain photo and architect’s description.
